# __NAME__

Backend service `__NAME__` (Go, D-0004). It implements the runtime contract in
[engineering.md](../../docs/standards/engineering.md#runtime-contract) and has no business logic yet.

## Environment

| Variable | Default | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `SERVICE_NAME` | `__NAME__` | Log attribute `service` |
| `VERSION` | `dev` | Log attribute `version`. Set at build time: `make image VERSION=<x>` (the image bakes it in as `ENV`); at runtime it can be overridden |
| `ENV` | `local` | Log attribute `env` |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error` |
| `APP_PORT` | `8080` | Public API port (behind Traefik) |
| `OPS_PORT` | `8081` | Probes only: `GET /livez`, `GET /readyz`. Never routed publicly |
| `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` | `20s` | Go duration, above 0 and at most 20s |

Every variable also accepts `<NAME>_FILE` (the value is read from that file), for file-based secrets.
Invalid values stop the service at startup and name the variable.

## Make targets

| Target | What it does |
|---|---|
| `make lint` | gofmt check, `go vet`, golangci-lint with the repository config |
| `make test` | Unit tests with `-race`; fails below 80 % coverage |
| `make build` | Static binary in `bin/service` |
| `make image` | Container image `$(IMAGE)` (default `har-__NAME__:local`) |

The service runs as `service`, with `service healthcheck` as the image health check.

Layout and rules: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
